the prophets and particularly the 8th Century prophets criticize and condemn the temple and its cult by saying things
like I will have mercy and not sacrifice or I do not Delight in the blood of bulls or incenses and Abomination to me

to situate it within its appropriate socio-historical context a lot of this rhetoric originates in the 8th Century
in the periods of Israel and then judah's greatest Prosperity when they are the most wealthy when they are engaged in the most International Trade
when they have kings that Reign for the longest and are the most powerful this is also periods of the greatest social
inequity and this is really the target of the prophetic critique it always is occurring alongside condemnation of the

what they're saying is that the purpose of the law is to create social and Cosmic Justice and order to minimize
